Best Source: Do NOT re-evaluate every title for every player every tick.

Titles register the trigger families they care about. When a matching event fires for a player only that player's candidate titles are re-checked. Plus one low-frequency sweep every 200 ticks for tick-sampler titles.
Once a title is earned it is removed from that player's candidate set permanently. The check cost drops as players progress.
